name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 12 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 following a stabbing attack on members of the Jewish community (gov.uk; AP). The Security Minister confirmed the level to Parliament on 14 May. Searches on 12 Nov found no announced change.
for_you: MI5 and counter-terrorism police advise the public to stay alert and report suspicious activity to police or the anti-terrorism hotline; ProtectUK carries guidance for venues and businesses.
rubric_hit: Alert: national threat level Severe (Severe or Critical line)
